name: marketing-product-gallery-cards
title: Product Gallery Cards
description: Original product cards that pair a hover image gallery with title, price, and description, in three levels of detail.
useWhen: Original product cards that pair a hover image gallery with title, price, and description, in three levels of detail.
avoidWhen: Avoid product gallery cards when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Product Gallery Cards uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
